Appendix G · The physical Pauli certificates

Equivalent physical Pauli strings can have different weights and overlaps. The listed representatives show which factory measurements fit together.

3 min core readingp. 65 · p. 66 · p. 67 · p. 68 · p. 69 · p. 70Coverage & audit

Appendix G. Make a logical measurement physically schedulable

A logical measurement must eventually specify operations on physical ions. Q66 encodes four logical qubits in 66 data qubits, and many physical Pauli strings represent the same encoded observable. Choosing among them determines the measurement's weight and compatibility with other measurements.

The freedom comes from stabilizers: they act as identity on encoded states. Multiplying an observable by a stabilizer changes its physical support without changing the logical action. The factory uses this to obtain narrow cat-mediated measurements and disjoint parallel readouts.

The binary certificate

The code is specified by a cyclic shift S on 33 sites, with Si,(i+1) mod 33=1S_{i,(i+1)\bmod33}=1Si,(i+1)mod33​=1. Its binary check matrices are

A=I+S+S3+S10,B=I+S+S8,HX=[A B],HZ=[BT AT].A=I+S+S^3+S^{10},\quad B=I+S+S^8,\qquad H_X=[A\ B],\quad H_Z=[B^T\ A^T].A=I+S+S3+S10,B=I+S+S8,HX​=[A B],HZ​=[BT AT].

A and B commute, giving HXHZT=0H_XH_Z^T=0HX​HZT​=0. Both check matrices have rank 31, leaving 66−31−31=466-31-31=466−31−31=4 logical qubits. Encode a physical Pauli by binary masks (x,z)(x,z)(x,z), where I, X, Z, Y are respectively 00, 10, 01, 11.

Legal logical operator

Zero syndrome requires HXz=HZx=0H_Xz=H_Zx=0HX​z=HZ​x=0, so the operator preserves the code space.

Commuting pair

Two physical Paulis commute when x⋅z′+z⋅x′=0x\cdot z'+z\cdot x'=0x⋅z′+z⋅x′=0, meaning an even number of local anticommutations.

Physical width

The weight is the number of sites with xi∨zi=1x_i\lor z_i=1xi​∨zi​=1; a Y counts as one occupied site.

Parallelism requires more than commutation

Disjoint supports permit independent physical couplings. The drawing gives a concrete pair before comparing it with commuting operators that share sites.

The example distinguishes algebraic commutation from physical readout compatibility. XX and ZZ commute, but require different bases on both shared sites. The search must find representatives whose physical requirements fit the proposed parallel measurement, not merely commuting logical labels.

Which measurements must fit a cat?

Only measurements mediated by cats are constrained by cat weight. Destructive final readout has a different physical requirement, so its strings are counted separately.

Source tableRoleNumber of stringsLargest weight
XVParallel Y injections216
XVIAcceptance check1616
XVIIThree CCZ-consumption observables4816
XVIIIProtected phase-fixup singleton1816
XIXTerminal destructive triple2418
XXTerminal destructive pair8222

The weight-16 limit applies to cat-mediated Q66 measurements. Terminal destructive measurements read each site directly and can use strings up to weight 22 without a weight-22 cat. The table separates these two uses.

Change the questions, recover the same answers

Sometimes changing the measured generators gives better supports. Replace the third question by P0P2P_0P_2P0​P2​, while keeping P0,P1P_0,P_1P0​,P1​. Their sign bits obey

(v0,v1,v2)=(u0,u1,u0⊕u2),(u0,u1,u2)=(v0,v1,v0⊕v2).(v_0,v_1,v_2)=(u_0,u_1,u_0\oplus u_2),\qquad (u_0,u_1,u_2)=(v_0,v_1,v_0\oplus v_2).(v0​,v1​,v2​)=(u0​,u1​,u0​⊕u2​),(u0​,u1​,u2​)=(v0​,v1​,v0​⊕v2​).
so all original outcomes are recovered exactly by XOR.

For measured bits 101, the inverse XOR relation returns original bits 100. Changing the measured generators preserves the information needed for cleanup.

The current Clifford frame determines which logical observables and signs these questions represent. A list of physical strings must therefore be paired with that branch information to interpret the measurement results.

What the certificates establish

All 190 listed strings have been checked for length, weight, zero syndrome, and commutation matching their logical labels. Parallel classes in Tables XV, XVII, XIX, and XX also have disjoint supports. These binary checks establish the listed compatibility properties; full circuit fault distance requires its own propagation analysis.

Exact records for reuse

The 190 representative records are available as JSON grouped by source table. Each string runs from qubit 0 at the left to qubit 65 at the right, with overall phases tracked separately.

Notation and physical meaning

Definitions are also given where they are used. Open the full notation page.

ppp — field prime
Coordinates lie in the finite field Fp\mathbb F_pFp​, the integers modulo ppp. For secp256k1, p=2256−232−977p=2^{256}-2^{32}-977p=2256−232−977. This modulus controls coordinate arithmetic. Use in the construction
ppp — local error probability
On architecture and state-preparation pages, ppp is the error probability specified beside the formula: for example, a physical two-qubit Pauli error rate or an injected-state fault rate. Each model defines the event and operation counted. Arithmetic pages instead use ppp for the field prime. Use in the construction
rrr — subgroup order
The number of distinct multiples of the generator point PPP; [r]P=O[r]P=\mathcal O[r]P=O. Scalar recovery is modulo rrr, not the field prime ppp. Use in the construction
ddd — secret scalar
The unknown element of Zr\mathbb Z_rZr​ satisfying Q=[d]PQ=[d]PQ=[d]P. Recovering it is the elliptic-curve discrete logarithm problem. Use in the construction
P,Q,OP,Q,\mathcal OP,Q,O — curve points
PPP is the chosen generator, QQQ is the public input point, and O\mathcal OO is the identity element of the curve group. [a]P[a]P[a]P denotes repeated point addition. Use in the construction
ccc — small prime offset
p=2n−cp=2^n-cp=2n−c, so 2n≡c(modp)2^n\equiv c\pmod p2n≡c(modp). For secp256k1, n=256n=256n=256 and c=232+977c=2^{32}+977c=232+977. This relation makes reduction of high bits cheap. Use in the construction
www — scalar-window width
The number of scalar bits handled by one coherent point lookup. The main loop uses w=16w=16w=16, giving tables indexed by 16-bit addresses. Use in the construction
λ\lambdaλ — point-addition slope
For distinct affine points with different x coordinates, λ=(y2−y1)/(x2−x1)\lambda=(y_2-y_1)/(x_2-x_1)λ=(y2​−y1​)/(x2​−x1​) in Fp\mathbb F_pFp​. The division means multiplication by a modular inverse. Elsewhere the same Greek letter may denote a Poisson mean; each lesson specifies its domain. Use in the construction
pfp_fpf​ — approximate-oracle failure bound
For each fixed input pair, an upper bound over fresh random masks on producing either wrong coordinates or a wrong relative phase. Appendix B obtains pf≤0.03346p_f\le0.03346pf​≤0.03346. Use in the construction
P0P_0P0​ — ideal algorithm success
Success probability assigned to exact arithmetic with the selected quantum Fourier measurement and classical recovery procedure. The rigorous and heuristic starting estimates must be kept separate. Use in the construction
QFT / iQFT — quantum Fourier transform
A unitary change of basis between a modular coordinate and its phase frequency. iQFT denotes its inverse. Measuring the result exposes the periodic relation used to recover the secret scalar. Use in the construction
CCX — Toffoli gate
The three-bit reversible map (a,b,t)↦(a,b,t⊕ab)(a,b,t)\mapsto(a,b,t\oplus ab)(a,b,t)↦(a,b,t⊕ab). It is a controlled-controlled-X gate and the main non-Clifford logical resource of the arithmetic. Use in the construction
CCZ — controlled-controlled-Z
The three-qubit unitary ∣a,b,c⟩↦(−1)abc∣a,b,c⟩|a,b,c\rangle\mapsto(-1)^{abc}|a,b,c\rangle∣a,b,c⟩↦(−1)abc∣a,b,c⟩. Conjugating its third qubit by Hadamards gives a Toffoli. A CCZ resource state is CCZ∣+⟩⊗3\mathrm{CCZ}|+\rangle^{\otimes3}CCZ∣+⟩⊗3. Use in the construction
TTT — pi-over-four phase gate
T=diag⁡(1,eiπ/4)T=\operatorname{diag}(1,e^{i\pi/4})T=diag(1,eiπ/4). A T state, up to the convention specified in a lesson, supplies this non-Clifford phase through state injection. The symbol TTT also denotes time in resource equations, where units are explicit. Use in the construction
Clifford frame — tracked logical transformation
A Clifford unitary maps Pauli operators to Pauli operators by conjugation. Instead of applying every such gate physically, the controller can track the accumulated map and reinterpret later measurements. Use in the construction
CliNR — Clifford noise-reduction protocol
Logical CliNR uses a prepared, checked Clifford resource and teleportation. Here it is used to clear a complicated tracked Clifford frame and restore simple logical-measurement representatives. Use in the construction
Q102 — main memory code
The quantum code [[102,22,9]][[102,22,9]][[102,22,9]]: 102 data qubits encode 22 logical qubits with distance 9. Device counts additionally include syndrome ancillas and replacement ions. Use in the construction
Q66 — factory code
The quantum code [[66,4,10]][[66,4,10]][[66,4,10]]: 66 data qubits encode four logical qubits with distance 10. It protects the CCZ-factory state and supports the specific representatives tabulated in Appendix G. Use in the construction
C6 — six-qubit detection code
The [[6,2,2]][[6,2,2]][[6,2,2]] code encodes two logical qubits. In the factory it prepares a pair of low-error logical H states using error detection and postselection. Use in the construction
Cat state — shared parity-measurement resource
A length-m cat is (∣0⟩⊗m+∣1⟩⊗m)/2(|0\rangle^{\otimes m}+|1\rangle^{\otimes m})/\sqrt2(∣0⟩⊗m+∣1⟩⊗m)/2​. Each cat qubit touches at most one target qubit when measuring a product Pauli operator, limiting fault spread. Use in the construction
POC — physical operation cycle
The basic physical timing unit used in the architecture, 0.2 ms0.2\,\mathrm{ms}0.2ms. Gate, transport, and syndrome schedules are expressed in these units. Use in the construction
SEC — syndrome-extraction cycle
One repeated measurement of the code's error checks with its physical schedule. Q102 takes 27 POCs per SEC; Q66 takes 17 POCs per SEC under the stated architecture. Use in the construction
LM / LM2 — logical measurement
LM denotes a measurement of a logical Pauli operator. LM2 spans two code blocks and requires resources that join their local cat states. A logical operation can take several SECs to achieve enough readout confidence. Use in the construction
supp⁡(P)\operatorname{supp}(P)supp(P) — Pauli support
The physical qubits on which a Pauli string PPP acts as X, Y, or Z rather than I. Its cardinality is the operator weight. Commuting operators need not have disjoint supports. Use in the construction
Logical representative — physical realization of an encoded Pauli
Different physical Pauli strings can implement the same logical operation because multiplying by a stabilizer leaves the encoded action unchanged. Choosing representatives controls weight and parallel compatibility. Use in the construction
gcd — greatest common divisor
The largest integer dividing two inputs. Binary-gcd updates use parity tests, subtraction, and division by two. Recording and replaying these updates implements modular multiplication or division reversibly. Use in the construction
κ\kappaκ — truncated carry width
The number of low bits through which a small modular correction is allowed to propagate. A carry beyond that range is one of the approximate arithmetic failure events. Use in the construction
DmeasD_{\rm meas}Dmeas​ — charged measurement depth
The sum of scheduled logical-measurement layers, including the expected penalties used in the resource accounting: 75,251,329 for the reported computation. Use in the construction
τ\tauτ — seconds per charged layer
Appendix E23 uses the unrounded value 0.0294958 s0.0294958\,\mathrm{s}0.0294958s. Table I displays it as 29.50 ms. Runtime is DmeasτD_{\rm meas}\tauDmeas​τ. Use in the construction
Postselection — accept only verified preparations
A preparation attempt is retained only if specified measurement checks pass; otherwise it restarts. Output error is conditioned on acceptance, and retries affect throughput. Use in the construction
pswapp_{\rm swap}pswap​ — survivor-displacement probability
Conditional on a two-qubit interaction involving a loss, the probability that the surviving ion is displaced to the other position. It is not the ordinary two-qubit Pauli error probability. Use in the construction
